newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom sale ad campaign starts wk of May 1.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom sale ad campaign starts wk of May 1.

text.p: The advertising campaign for the privatisation of France Telecom is to start in the week of May 1 and will run for over three weeks, an executive at advertising agency Alice, which is handling the campaign, told Reuters on Wednesday.
France Telecom said earlier on Wednesday that a share flotation for at least 25 billion francs was scheduled for May, but the exact dates had not been fixed.

French newspaper La Tribune said a six-day public offer of shares representing 20 percent of France Telecom was scheduled to begin on May 20, with stock trading expected to start at the beginning of June.
No one was immediately available for comment at the finance and industry ministries.
